hero.title: Smart Ordering for Your Cafe & Outlet.
hero.subtitle: Empower your small restaurant with QR ordering. Customers scan, order, and pay instantly—no app or login required.

testimonials.name: Rajesh K.
testimonials.content: Restro made our morning rush so much easier. Customers scan the QR at the counter and order while waiting. No more long queues!

testimonials.name: Sarah M.
testimonials.content: The fact that customers don't need to login is a game changer. Ordering is instant, and my sales have actually gone up.

testimonials.name: Anand V.
testimonials.content: I can update my menu from my phone in seconds. If we run out of a dish, I just mark it as sold out instantly.

faqs.question: Do customers really not need to login?
faqs.answer: Yes! Frictionless ordering is our core promise. Customers simply scan the QR, add items to their cart, and place the order. No email or phone number required.

faqs.question: What kind of hardware do I need?
faqs.answer: None. You can manage your entire restaurant from a smartphone, tablet, or laptop. Just print your QR codes and you're good to go.

faqs.question: Is it really free?
faqs.answer: Our Starter plan is 100% free with all the core features you need to run your outlet. Paid plans with advanced features are coming soon.

faqs.question: Can I use it for takeaways?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can place a QR code at your counter for takeaway orders to reduce wait times during peak hours.
